title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Illinois Institute of Technology
description: Ten under-21-safe food and snack stops with directly verified late hours, ranging from Bronzeville and Bridgeport to nearby 24-hour diners.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell at 3365 S Martin Luther King Drive
cards.title: Tacos Close to Campus
cards.subtitle: 3365 S Martin Luther King Drive in Bronzeville
cards.notes: Check the location page before leaving, then use this nearby counter for a late meal without making a long trip from campus.
cards.short_summary: A close-to-campus fast-food option with service extending well beyond midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official Chicago directory lists the restaurant at 3365 S Martin Luther King Drive as an open-late location closing at 3:00 a.m.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurants in Chicago, Illinois
cards.access_notes: The official directory currently lists closing at 3:00 a.m.; confirm the location page before departure because operating hours can change.

cards.title: Bridgeport After Midnight
cards.subtitle: 252 W 26th Street in Bridgeport
cards.notes: Head west from campus for sandwiches or pizza, noting that Friday and Saturday provide the longest verified ordering window.
cards.short_summary: A named Bridgeport restaurant whose weekend schedule reaches 2:00 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Ricobene’s official website lists hours until 12:30 a.m. Monday–Thursday, 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and midnight Sunday.
cards.source_title: Ricobene's – Authentic Italian Restaurant in Chicago, IL
cards.access_notes: Open until 12:30 a.m. Monday–Thursday, 2:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and midnight Sunday, according to the official site.

cards.title: Fried Seafood Around the Clock
cards.subtitle: 2120 S Canal Street near Chinatown and Pilsen
cards.notes: Use the Canal Street location specifically—the company lists its other area restaurants with earlier closing times.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour fried-seafood counter southwest of campus with its own identifiable storefront.
cards.evidence_claim: Lawrence’s official website identifies its Canal Street restaurant at 2120 S Canal Street and states that it is open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Lawrence's Fish & Shrimp | Chicago Famous Fried Seafood
cards.access_notes: The official restaurant website lists the Canal Street location as open 24 hours; verify before making a very late trip.

cards.title: An All-Night Cermak Diner
cards.subtitle: 1174 W Cermak Road in Pilsen
cards.notes: Choose this specific Chicago location for diner food at any hour, and confirm the posted schedule before setting out overnight.
cards.short_summary: A classic counter-service diner on Cermak Road with an official 24/7 schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Steak 'N Egger’s official location page gives the Chicago address as 1174 W Cermak Road and lists its hours as 24/7.
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists 24/7 hours; call ahead if traveling during a holiday or overnight service disruption.

cards.title: South Loop Diner at Any Hour
cards.subtitle: 1159 S Canal Street in the South Loop
cards.notes: Walk in without a reservation for diner fare, but check current conditions before relying on overnight indoor service.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable South Loop diner serving breakfast and comfort food throughout the night.
cards.evidence_claim: White Palace Grill’s official FAQ identifies the restaurant at 1159 S Canal Street as a 24-hour diner and says reservations are not required.
cards.source_title: Frequently Asked Questions – White Palace Grill
cards.access_notes: The official FAQ says the diner is open 24 hours and welcomes walk-ins at any time; confirm before an overnight visit.

cards.title: A Garfield Boulevard Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: 242 W Garfield Boulevard in Washington Park
cards.notes: Check whether dine-in or drive-thru service fits your group; both schedules currently extend into the early morning.
cards.short_summary: A South Side fast-food stop with verified service until at least 3:30 a.m. nightly.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official location page lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until 3:30 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru close at 3:30 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; holiday hours may vary.

cards.entity_name: South Loop Market at 1720 S Michigan Avenue
cards.title: A Midnight Snack-Shelf Run
cards.subtitle: 1720 S Michigan Avenue in the South Loop
cards.notes: Use this market for packaged food and everyday supplies, with Friday and Saturday providing the latest listed closing time.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood market north of campus that stays open past midnight on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: South Loop Market’s official locations page lists its 1720 S Michigan Avenue store until midnight Monday–Thursday, 12:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and 11:00 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Monday–Thursday, 12:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday, and 11:00 p.m. Sunday on the official locations page.

cards.title: Coffee and Snacks at 2 A.M.
cards.subtitle: 1231 S Wabash Avenue in the South Loop
cards.notes: Select the Wabash Avenue listing in the app or website so your order routes to the verified 24-hour South Loop shop.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour coffee-and-snack counter on the direct northbound route from campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Dunkin’s official location page identifies the shop at 1231 S Wabash Avenue and lists it as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: Dunkin' at 1231 S Wabash Ave in Chicago
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists 24-hour service Monday through Sunday; verify before relying on overnight counter access.

cards.title: Halsted Before Midnight
cards.subtitle: 3020 S Halsted Street in Bridgeport
cards.notes: Plan this as a before-midnight stop rather than an all-night run; the official page gives the same closing time all week.
cards.short_summary: A Bridgeport fast-food counter with a consistent midnight closing schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s official restaurant page lists lobby and restaurant hours at 3020 S Halsted Street from 5:00 a.m. to midnight every day.
cards.source_title: McDonald's at 3020 S Halsted St, Chicago
cards.access_notes: The official page lists restaurant and lobby hours through midnight daily; arrive earlier to allow for ordering.

cards.title: Chicago Street Food Until 1 A.M.
cards.subtitle: 520 W Taylor Street near University Village
cards.notes: Allow extra travel time from campus and check holiday notices; the dining room and drive-thru share the same listed schedule.
cards.short_summary: A family-friendly Chicago fast-food destination with nightly service until 1:00 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Portillo’s official location page lists its Canal and Taylor restaurant and drive-thru as open from 10:00 a.m. to 1:00 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed until 1:00 a.m. daily; the official page notes that holiday hours may vary.
